versions.changelog:
- Introduced review-common-core skill as a shared infrastructure for all review-related skills.
- Provides reusable frameworks and checklists for segment annotation, holistic review, core review principles, fact-check classification, and self-checklists.
- Not designed to run independently; other review skills cite documents from its references/ directory.
- Added JSON validation scripts for review checklists and theme consistency.
- Centralized reference system improves consistency and reusability across multiple review skills.
